p.t: In The Eye Of The Storm: Chasers
p.d: In May 2024, eyewitnesses capture rare twin tornadoes carving a parallel path across Iowa. With winds near 300 mph, the twister sisters flatten farms, shred wind turbines, and devastate the town of Greenfield.

Peter and Jason enter a demolition derby for the first time in hopes of winning a free truck from the current champ; Wreckless Restorations take on their biggest build yet, turning an old Ford work truck into a high-performance hot rod.

As winter winds down, the Browns prepare for a medieval-themed birthday celebration for Baby Eli; pushing through the pandemic, the Browns complete the main house just before a massive wildfire strikes the mountain.

A morning walk has gone tragically wrong for Tigger and his distressed owner Bernadette. A street cleaner spooked it and sent him charging into a car. Chris is trying to calm them both down to find out the extent of his injuries.

Ziggy is a dog with an embarrassing problem. A huge mass is hanging off his back leg. Bemused vet nurse Neil tells us it's like a third testicle swinging in the wind. But when it comes to surgery it's no laughing matter for Chris.

Boris the Staffy was born with a cleft palate and seven operations have failed. Jess won't give up, so Chris attempts Australia's first surgery of its kind—raising eight grand to give Boris one last chance.

West Highland terrier, Chester lives in Bondi but has a fanatical hatred of skateboarders. It’s a dangerous combination and one that is making life hell for his owners Mark and Jess. They’re worried Chester could bite someone.

6 month old German Shepherd, Gypsy hasn't been able to keep any food down for weeks and is losing weight rapidly. But getting to the bottom of the problem is proving impossible as the petrified patient refuses to let anybody examine her.
A critically ill swan has been found caught up in a soccer net in a suburban backyard. The bird is emaciated and running out of time. Has Chris arrived in time to save the swan from certain death?
Poppy is a Fijian native dog whose nose was cut off in a horrific hunting accident, Chris has brought her to Australia for major reconstructive surgery and hopefully a whole new life.

One year-old Hero has been vomiting all day and his owners are worried he’s been up to his old tricks eating rocks from their backyard. Can Lisa help the naughty Labrador pass the rock or will he be forced to have major surgery?

Ziggy the cat has a big problem - he weighs almost a third more than he should. Chris needs to re-educate both the cat and the devoted owner to ensure the cats' deteriorating health is not compromised further.

Chris heads to Cornwall, UK. He's flat-out treating a dairy calf needing urgent surgery, a prize-winning duck with a torn foot, and a Siberian eagle owl with a bung eye, and giving two Atlantic grey seals the all-clear for release.

In an emotion charged episode, Chris is on a desperate rescue mission to save the life of a frail 3-day old orphan foal. Brulee has lost his mum and won't survive unless Chris can find him a surrogate. But it's no guarantee a mare will accept the little foal.

Chris meets a labradoodle with a chronic sneezing problem. 2 year old Lulu suffers massive sneezing fits up to 4 times a day, and her devoted owner Kim is desperate for help. Chris fears Lulu may have a tumor.
Chris heads to Abu Dhabi after a special invitation to visit an extraordinary veterinary hospital, where sick and injured falcons are treated like royalty.

A tiny kitten has been found abandoned in a cardboard box, and Chris is shocked at the extent of her injuries. She desperately needs surgery to try to repair her shattered leg. Then it's a heartwarming search to find her a new home.

p.t: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
p.d: When an ancient emperor's tomb is discovered in the 1940s, Rick O'Connell and his wife become involved in a plot to restore the emperor to power.

Invited by her long-lost family to a lavish wedding in the English countryside, a woman gets thrust into a nightmare of survival as she uncovers twisted secrets and the unsettling intentions behind their sinful generosity.
In the distant future, Cypher Raige and his son Kitai crash-land on an unfamiliar and dangerous Earth. With Cypher injured, Kitai must trek across the hostile terrain to recover their rescue beacon.

p.t: The Fast and the Furious: Tokyo Drift
p.d: Following run-ins with the authorities due to his street racing, an American moves to Japan with his father. He feels more isolated in his new home until he finds out about a new, exciting sport.

A veteran cop and an assassin track an ex-convict who is on a mission to take revenge on his brother's killers.

During an expedition Dr Rick Marshall, his research assistant, and a redneck survivalist are sucked into a space-time vortex. They find themselves in an alternate universe and become friends with a primate named Chaka.

p.d: Lt Frank Debrin uncovers a plot by the polluting energy giants to derail ecological plans that could render their products redundant. They're led by the evil Quentin Hapsburg who, to make matters worse, is romancing Frank's ex, Jane Spencer.
A greedy network executive receives an attitude adjustment from three ghosts after firing a member of his staff during the Christmas season.

p.t: You Don't Mess With the Zohan
p.d: Zohan Dvir is an Israeli Special Forces soldier commando who fakes his own death so he can become a New York hairdresser.
Veteran comedy writer Charlie Burnz and New York City singer Emma Payge form an unlikely, yet touching, friendship.

In 1999 the old sport of skiing had just been given new life, and Level 1 was conceived to document its progress into the future. With twenty years in the rearview mirror it still stands true- new things never get old. Romance, the final chapter of annual films by Level 1, captures a modern-day Golden Age in skiing. Featuring a generation of talent that came of age in the best time to ever do it. Tweaking the formula, tweaking the grab, and in it for nothing but the love.

Small World examines the universal dialect of moving down snow on two feet through a lens of fresh perspective- documenting the outer niches of a sport pushed under the rug by the modern day ski zeitgeist.
S4 E17Behind the Gate follows the MXGP paddock to the Netherlands for fierce battles on the Dutch sand.

A weekend of passion, home support, and racing history!

p.t: Just Getting Started - The Life We Chose
p.d: S1 E1The first glimpse behind the scenes of the Norco Race Division on the opening weekend of the UCI Downhill World Cup in Fort William, Scotland. An unfiltered view into the life chosen by the team riders, led by the legendary Greg Minnaar, with access to the emotions, tribulations, and passion for the sport.

Fusing the indigenous tradition of playing on waves with the route of São Tomé e Príncipe's most talented young surfer, Jejé Camblé, "Surf Próprio" narrates the tale of surfing in São Tomé, from cultural connection between a group of children in Santana, to the country's first participation in the World Junior Surfing Championships.

S1 E8Clark Little describes his workout routine, films world surfing champion John John Florence, and shares some techniques and trials of shooting shorebreak. Another quite interesting episode of this phenomenal series that follows Little around the island of Oahu while looking for unique photographic opportunities.

S1 E9Clark Little shares his passion with fans and fellow photographers on the promotional tour for the Shorebreak documentary, that follow the Hawaiian lensman around the island of Oahu, capturing its waves in unprecedent fashion.

S1 E1Meet three-time world longboard champion, Colin McPhillips and see the inside life of this California kid. Colin gives a tour of his home town of San Clemente and checks in with world renown shaper Bill Stewart as he shapes his signature model. Then, set off on a journey up the east coast of New Zealands north island to find perfect surf on the Corimandel Peninsula. The episode wraps up with a trip to the sand toy capitol of the world of Glamis dunes where Colin spends some downtime on his dune buggy.

On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Gloucester, Massachusetts to investigate Hammond Castle.

The Atlantic Paranormal Society travels to the city of Rochester in the state of New York to uncover a haunting secret that the Rochester Public Library, an establishment that has been around since 1801, has kept below the radar for 15 years.

TAPS travels to San Juan Capistrano, California to investigate the San Juan Capistrano Mission.
Renovations at Peoria Asylum in Bartonville, Illinois, are slowed down by strange occurrences, which are investigated by the team.
On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Cortland, New York to investigate The 1890 House.
On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Louisville, Kentucky to investigate one of the oldest operating steamboats in the United States, The Belle of Louisville.

A mysterious tablet discovered on a distant planet infects anyone who touches it with a hallucinogen.
SG-1 discovers a planet where children are used to acquire knowledge for the entire population, then discarded.
Point Of View: When an alternate reality of Earth is invaded by the Goa'uld, their version of Dr Samantha Carter, along with Major Kawalsky, seeks refuge with Stargate Command.

SG-1 travels to planet PJ6-877 for a routine recon. Almost immediately after arriving, they are snared in an invisible forcefield by alien bounty hunter Aris Boch. Aris takes them to his cargo ship, which is completely invisible from the outside. He has come to this planet to hunt a Goa'uld named Kel'tar, who is wanted by the evil system lord Sokar.
SG-1 finds a medieval Christian society terrorized by Sokar and the Unas, and is accused of being possessed by demons.

Upon exiting the stargate, SG-1 finds itself in the midst of battle. A group of SG soldiers battles a Jaffa army. Believing the soldiers to be the missing-in-action SG-11 team, Col. Jack O'Neill and the others provide assistance. Much to their surprise, the mystery SG team turns their weapons against SG-1! SG-1 wakes up in the soldiers' training camp with headaches and no weapons.

During a rescue of captured Abydonians, Daniel finds his missing wife, Sha're. But instead of greeting him, she attacks him - leading to her death at the hands of Teal'c. Distraught over her death and angry at Teal'c, Daniel quits Stargate Command.
SG-1 encounters an entire planet suffering from amnesia. The planet's leader returns to Earth with SG-1 to find a cure.
Carter's father has been captured on a moon transformed into hell. Only Jolinar's memories can save him.

During a rescue attempt, SG-1 is caught by one of hell's denizens, who is determined to use the information they have to overthrow Goa'uld lord Sokar. Using Tok'ra technology, the team is forced to relive painful memories... but how much can they take?
Foothold: The team returns from a mission to find that no one at the Stargate Command is who they appear to be.
The Tollan Narim invites SG-1 to participate in a ritual known as Triad. Only when SG-1 shows up do they learn that Triad is a ceremony of justice.

En route to a planet, the SG-1 are implanted with an alien spore that evolves into a being called Urgo. Though Urgo claims to be friendly, the suspicious team members work feverishly to rid themselves of the creature before it destroys their minds.
After a meteor strike buries the Stargate, O'Neill finds himself stranded on a planet with no hope of rescue.

SG-1 travels to Tollana to negotiate a trade. Col. Jack O'Neill becomes extremely annoyed when the Tollans refuse to cooperate, due to their fear that any weaponry given to Earth would more likely be used on itself than to protect against the Goa'uld.

The Hard Merchandise is the only boat not to land a fish, and Captain Dave Marciano is feeling the pressure to provide for his family and bring home a paycheck. Meanwhile, Captain TJ Ott welcomes his father and 10-year-old nephew aboard.

It's tournament time in Gloucester and when inexperienced fishermen - or googans as the commercial fleet refer to them - crowd the water, the fleet has to fight through additional aggravating obstacles standing in their way of earning a paycheck. While googans wreak havoc with their carelessness, some commercial boats will manage to land fish against the odds while others will go home empty-handed. And one boat will score the biggest payday so far this season, but not without a fight.

The captains team up to double their chances of catching fish, but forming an alliance with a competitor is risky. Captain Tyler McLaughlin of the Pinwheel is forced to fish solo and joins forces with Captain Brad Krasowski of the Fish Hawk to get some much-needed assistance on deck. And Captain Paul Hebert of the Wicked Pissah teams up with Captain TJ Ott of the Hot Tuna.

The alliances within the fleet begin to prosper — or fall apart. Captains Tyler McLaughlin and Brad Krasowski have a successful partnership that’s keeping their boats on top. Things aren’t as smooth for Captains TJ Ott and Paul Hebert, as Ott’s tendency to overshare information has Hebert giving Ott the silent treatment.
After an unusually slow start to the season, defending champion Captain Dave Carraro and his vessel are back on top. The fleet will do everything in its power to cool Dot Com's hot streak.

Before and after a storm bluefin tuna go on a feeding frenzy, so for boat captains willing to take the risk of going out on the water the rewards can be great. Last year when bad weather hit the fishing grounds Hot Tuna's captain, TJ Ott, was cautious, sitting out the bad weather at the dock while other boats caught fish and moved up in earnings. This week the competition is close with only few hundred dollars separating the top contenders and no one wants to miss a chance at taking the top spot.

It's the halfway point of the season, and with the pressure for bluefin intensifying, tensions rise for captains and their crews. And while some teams work together under the mounting pressure for paychecks, others begin to fall apart.
Paul's negative attitude sours his relationship with his mate, Rick. Tyler is forced to fish solo after his mate doesn't show up for work.

After a few solid weeks of fishing, Captain Dave Carraro of the FV-Tuna.com is feeling confident about his chances of taking the top spot again. But Captain Brad Krasowski of the Fish Hawk, who finished at the bottom of the leaderboard last year, is on a hot streak and is ready to make good on his promise to go from “worst to first.”
Coming into week 12, there are several boats in the fleet that have been struggling lately. Meanwhile FV-Tuna.com and Fish Hawk have been on a tear pulling away from the rest of the fleet.

There are three weeks left in the Bluefin tuna fishing season as the fleet battles for final paychecks and the title of Gloucester's top earning fishing boat. Pinwheel is in the lead for the first time in six weeks and determined to hold that lead until the last day of the season. Last year's worst performing boat, Fish Hawk, is breathing down Pinwheel's neck in second position. Four-time champion FV-Tuna.Com plays catch up, trailing in third position and not happy about it. While Hot Tuna continues their successful season coming of a two fish catch last week but they haven't been in the top spot in nine weeks. Also looking to move up the ladder of profit and glory is Wicked Pissah who has been in the lead position only once this season. While Hard Merchandise tries desperately to make any kind of profit for the family. Who will bring in the fish and who could crack under the pressure?

The FV-Tuna.com has been the top-earning boat in the fleet for the past two years. Dave Carraro is confident his team can finish out the season strong, but the rest of the fleet is in hot pursuit. Tyler McLaughlin knows that he needs to turn every single hookup into a catch in order to take the lead away from Carraro. And Brad Krasowski is just one big catch away.

With only one week left in bluefin season, the fleet competes for final paychecks and the championship. Longtime champion FV-Tuna.com and rival boat Pinwheel are forced off the water by illness and injury, and having the two top contenders out of the race is a game-changer for the fleet, pushing everyone to go for broke to score an upset and become Gloucester’s top-earning boat.

With less than 4 days left in the North Atlantic Bluefin Tuna season, the fleet race to claim the title of Gloucester's top earning bluefin boat. But with two top contenders, last season's champion Captain Dave Carraro of FV-Tuna.com and previous top-earner Captain Tyler McLaughlin on the Pinwheel, potentially sidelined, the field is wide open and it will all come down to the last fish.

It's opening day of the bluefin tuna season; after a mediocre performance in the Outer Banks, Capt. Dave Marciano is ready for his first season aboard his new boat, the Falcon; Capt. Tyler McLaughlin copes with the unexpected loss of his mate.
